During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] '''annexed''' the neutral [[Vyron system/Legends|Vyron system]] as part of their [[Annexation of neutral systems|recent expansion]]. The Republic [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvette]] [[Outrider (Thranta-class corvette)|''Outrider'']] witnessed the end of the battle, but complied with the Cartel's orders to depart in order to prevent a conflict.<ref name="Karagga" />
